state_law.task_structure: Infer the unique rank-(p-1) token permutation satisfying coordinate(outcome)=coordinate(left)+coordinate(right) mod p from training batch generation facts.
state_law.formation: The first validation-grid rule score >=0.3 anchors a 600-step decay-exposure lag; the held-out algebraic margin and cyclic embedding spectrum are prefix diagnostics of the same state.
state_law.curve: A cut-calibrated sigmoid evolves to the transition; after formation a stable 0.965 rule plateau is modulated by a bounded optimizer-stress pulse.
state_law.stability: Stress phase advances modulo 400 steps, with inclusive +/-100-step vulnerability intervals; amplitude is explicitly not asserted invariant.
state_law.optimizer_scaling: The 600-step lag scales inversely with prefix AdamW learning-rate times decayed-group weight decay, clamped to the supported range.

uncertainty.transition: The 200-step interval is a precision diagnostic; the 400-wide primary interval carries the one-run cross-initialization uncertainty.
uncertainty.instability: Pulse timing is interval-valued and pulse depth is a mean law because observed peak spacings vary from 300 to 500 steps and catastrophic amplitude is not invariant.
